original: Brahmayācanakathā
content: 梵天勸請的談論[SN.6.1]

original: 64.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者想這個：

original: ‘ yaṃnūnāhaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan’ ti.
content: 『讓我教導法。』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者想這個：

original: ‘ adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
content: 『被我到達(證得)的這個法是甚深的、難見的、難覺的、寂靜的、勝妙的、[[atakkāvacaro#超越推論的]]、微妙的、被賢智者體驗的。

original: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
content: 然而，這[[pajāya#世代]]是樂於[[ālaya#阿賴耶]]的、好於阿賴耶的、[[ālayarāmā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā#喜於阿賴耶的]]。

original: Ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
content: 又，對樂於阿賴耶的、好於阿賴耶的、喜於阿賴耶的世代，此處是難見的，即：[[idappaccayatā#特定條件性]]、[[paṭiccasamuppādaṃ#緣起]]；

original: Idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
content: 此處也是難見的，即：[[sabbasaṅkhārasamathe#一切行的止]]、一切[[upadhiṃ#依著]]的[[paṭinissagga#斷念]]、渴愛的滅盡、[[virāgo#離貪]]、[[nirodhaṃ#滅]]、涅槃。

original: Ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ;
content: 那樣的話，如果我教導法，對方不能了解我，

original: so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā’ ti.
content: 那對我是疲勞，[[so mamassa kilamatho#那對我是傷害]]。』(64)

original: 65.‘‘ Apissu, bhikkhave, vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā–
content: 於是，這些在以前前所未聞的，[[anacchariyaṃ#不可思議]]的[[gāthāya,gāthā#偈頌]]在毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者心中出現：

original: ‘ Kicchena me adhigataṃ, halaṃ dāni pakāsituṃ;
content: 「被我困難到達，現在沒必要說明，

original: Rāgadosaparetehi , nāyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
content: 以被貪瞋征服者們，這個法是不容易正覺的。

original: ‘ Paṭisotagāmiṃ nipuṇaṃ, gambhīraṃ duddasaṃ aṇuṃ;
content: 對逆流行走的、微妙的，對甚深的、難見的、精細的，

original: Rāgarattā na dakkhanti, tamokhandhena āvuṭā’ ti.
content: 被貪染著者們沒看見：被大黑暗覆蓋者們。」

original: ‘ ‘ Itiha , bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya.
content: 在這裡，當毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者像這樣深慮時，心傾向[[appossukke#不活動]]，無法的教導。(65)

original: 66.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, aññatarassa mahābrahmuno vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi –
content: 那時，某位大梵王以心了知毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者心中的深思後，想這個：

original: ‘ nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati[ nami( syā. ka.), namissati(?)], no dhammadesanāyā’ ti.
content: 『唉！[[bho#先生]]！世界滅亡，唉！先生！世界消失，確實是因為毘婆尸世尊、[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]的心傾向不活動，無法的教導。』

original: Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mahābrahmā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya;
content: 比丘們！那時，那位大梵王就猶如有力氣的男子伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，

original: evameva brahmaloke antarahito vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa purato pāturahosi.
content: 就像這樣在梵天世界消失，出現在毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的面前。

original: Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mahābrahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ pathaviyaṃ nihantvā[ nidahanto( syā.)] yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！那時，那位大梵王置(作)上衣到一邊肩膀、右膝蓋觸地、向毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者[[añjaliṃ#合掌]]鞠躬後，對毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者說這個：

original: ‘ desetu, bhante, bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ, santi[ santī( syā.)] sattā apparajakkhajātikā;
content: 『大德！請世尊教導法！請善逝教導法！有少塵垢之類的眾生

original: assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro’ ti.
content: 以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。』(66)

original: 67.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte[ atha kho( ka.)], bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！在這麼說時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者對那位大梵王說這個：

original: ‘ mayhampi kho, brahme, etadahosi–
content: 『梵王！我想這個：

original: ‘‘ yaṃnūnāhaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan’’ ti.
content: 「讓我教導法。」

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, brahme, etadahosi–
content: 梵王！我想這個：

original: ‘‘ adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
content: 「被我到達的這個法是甚深的、難見的、難覺的、寂靜的、勝妙的、超越推論的、微妙的、被賢智者體驗的。

original: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
content: 然而，這世代有阿賴耶的快樂，樂於阿賴耶，喜於阿賴耶。

original: Ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
content: 又，對有阿賴耶的快樂，樂於阿賴耶，喜於阿賴耶的世代，此處是難見的，即：特定條件性、緣起；

original: Idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
content: 此處也是難見的，即：一切行的止、一切依著的斷念、渴愛的滅盡、離貪、滅、涅槃。

original: Ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ;
content: 那樣的話，如果我教導法，對方不能了解我，

original: so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā’’ ti.
content: 那對我是疲勞，那對我是傷害。」

original: Apissu maṃ, brahme , imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā–
content: 梵王！於是，這在以前前所未聞的，不可思議的偈頌在我心中出現：

original: ‘ ‘ Kicchena me adhigataṃ, halaṃ dāni pakāsituṃ;
content: 「被我困難到達，現在沒必要說明，

original: Rāgadosaparetehi , nāyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
content: 以被貪瞋征服者們，這個法是不容易正覺的。

original: ‘ ‘ Paṭisotagāmiṃ nipuṇaṃ, gambhīraṃ duddasaṃ aṇuṃ;
content: 對逆流行走的、微妙的，對甚深的、難見的、精細的，

original: Rāgarattā na dakkhanti, tamokhandhena āvuṭā’’ ti.
content: 被貪染著者們沒看見：被大黑暗覆蓋者們。」

original: ‘ Itiha me, brahme, paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāyā’ ti.
content: 梵王！當我像這樣深慮時，心傾向於不活動，不教導法。』(67)

original: 68.‘‘ Dutiyampi kho, bhikkhave, so mahābrahmā… pe… tatiyampi kho, bhikkhave, so mahābrahmā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！第二次，那位梵王又……（中略）第三次，那位梵王又對毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者說這個：

original: ‘ desetu, bhante, bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ, santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro’ ti.
content: 『大德！請世尊教導法！請善逝教導法！有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。』(68)

original: 69.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi.
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者知道梵天勸請後，[[paṭicca#緣於]]對眾生的悲愍，以[[cakkhumā, cakkhumatā#佛眼]]檢視世間。

original: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye[ duviññāpaye bhabbe abhabbe( syā.)] appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine[ dassāvino( sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.)] viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine[ dassāvino( sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.)] viharante.
content: 比丘們！那時，當毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者以佛眼檢視世間時，看見少塵垢的、多塵垢的；利根的、弱根的；[[svākāre#善行相的]]、惡行相的；易受教的、難受教的；一些住於看見在其他世界的罪過與恐怖的、另一些不住於看見在其他世界的罪過與恐怖的眾生，

original: Seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni anto nimuggaposīni.
content: 就猶如在青蓮池、紅蓮池、白蓮池中，一些青蓮、紅蓮、白蓮被生於水中，被長於水中，不被上升水中，被沈在內部養育的；

original: Appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni.
content: 一些青蓮、紅蓮、白蓮被生於水中，被長於水中，與水面同高而住立；

original: Appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakā accuggamma ṭhitāni anupalittāni udakena.
content: 一些青蓮、紅蓮、白蓮被生於水中，被長於水中，從水中上升後住立，不被水污染。

original: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
content: 同樣的，比丘們！當毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者以佛眼檢視世間時，看見少塵垢的、多塵垢的；利根的、弱根的；善行相的、惡行相的；易受教的、難受教的；一些住於看見在其他世界的罪過與恐怖的、另一些不住於看見在其他世界的罪過與恐怖的眾生。(69)

original: 70.‘‘ Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mahābrahmā vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi–
content: 比丘們！那時，那位大梵王以心了知毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者心中的深思後，以偈頌對毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者說：

original: ‘ Sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathāpi passe janataṃ samantato;
content: 『如在山頂岩石上站立者，如是都會看見各處的人群，

original: Tathūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedha, pāsādamāruyha samantacakkhu.
content: 極聰明者！像這樣的譬喻，[[cakkhumā, cakkhumatā#一切眼者]]！登上法所成的高樓後，

original: ‘ Sokāvatiṇṇaṃ [ sokāvakiṇṇaṃ( syā.)] janatamapetasoko,
content: 離憂愁者對陷入憂愁的人們，

original: Avekkhassu jātijarābhibhūtaṃ;
content: 請你向下注視被生老征服者。

original: Uṭṭhehi vīra vijitasaṅgāma,
content: 英雄！戰場勝利者！請你起來，

original: Satthavāha aṇaṇa vicara loke.
content: 商隊領袖！無負債者！請你在世間走動，

original: Desassu [ desetu( syā. pī.)] bhagavā dhammaṃ,
content: 世尊！請你教導法，

original: Aññātāro bhavissantī’ ti.
71.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者以偈頌對那位梵王說：

original: ‘ Apārutā tesaṃ amatassa dvārā,
content: 『不死之門已為他們打開：

original: Ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ;
content: 讓凡有耳者們脫離[邪]信，

original: Vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ na bhāsiṃ,
content: [[vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ#對諸惱害想的熟知者]]，

original: Dhammaṃ paṇītaṃ manujesu brahme’ ti.
content: 梵天！我不在人間說勝妙法。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mahābrahmā‘ katāvakāso khomhi vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammadesanāyā’ ti vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tattheva antaradhāyi.
content: 比丘們！那時，那位大梵王[心想]：『對教導法，我已被毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者允許。』向毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者[[abhivādetvā#問訊]]、[[padakkhiṇaṃ katvā#作右繞]]後，就在那裡消失。(71)

original: Aggasāvakayugaṃ
content: 最上的雙弟子

original: 72.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者想這個：

original: ‘ kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, ko imaṃ dhammaṃ khippameva ājānissatī’ ti?
content: 『我應該對誰第一個教導法呢？誰將迅速地了知這個法呢？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者想這個：

original: ‘ ayaṃ kho khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasanti paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvino dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātikā.
content: 『這位國王的兒子騫茶與司祭的兒子低舍居住在邦都馬低王都中，是賢智者、聰明者、有智慧者、長時間少塵垢之類者，

original: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ khaṇḍassa ca rājaputtassa, tissassa ca purohitaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ , te imaṃ dhammaṃ khippameva ājānissantī’ ti.
content: 讓我第一個為國王的兒子騫茶與司祭的兒子低舍教導法，他們將迅速地了知這個法。』(72)

original: 73.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya;
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者就猶如有力氣的男子能伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，

original: evameva bodhirukkhamūle antarahito bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā kheme migadāye pāturahosi.
content: 就像這樣波吒釐樹下消失，出現在邦都馬低王都的安穩(差摩)鹿林中。

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dāyapālaṃ[ migadāyapālaṃ( syā.)] āmantesi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者召喚守林人：

original: ‘ ehi tvaṃ, samma dāyapāla, bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā khaṇḍañca rājaputtaṃ tissañca purohitaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi– vipassī, bhante, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati, so tumhākaṃ dassanakāmo’ ti.
content: 『來！親愛的守林人！請你進入邦都馬低王都後，對國王的兒子騫茶與司祭的兒子低舍說這個：「大德！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者已抵達邦都馬低王都，住在安穩鹿林中，他是想見你們者。」』

original: ‘ Evaṃ, bhante’ ti kho, bhikkhave, dāyapālo vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā khaṇḍañca rājaputtaṃ tissañca purohitaputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 『是的，大德！』比丘們！守林人回答毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者後，進入邦都馬低王都，對國王的兒子騫茶與司祭的兒子低舍說這個：

original: ‘ vipassī, bhante, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto kheme migadāye viharati;
content: 『大德！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者已抵達邦都馬低王都的安穩鹿林中，

original: so tumhākaṃ dassanakāmo’ ti.
content: 他是想見你們者。』(73)

original: 74.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā niyyiṃsu.
content: 比丘們！那時，國王的兒子騫茶與司祭的兒子低舍準備一輛輛吉祥車、登上一輛輛吉祥車後，以一輛輛吉祥車從邦都馬低王都出發，

original: Yena khemo migadāyo tena pāyiṃsu.
content: 前往安穩鹿林。

original: Yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikāva[ padikāva( syā.)] yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
content: 以車輛一直走到車輛所及之地、再下車後，就步行去見毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者。

original: Upasaṅkamitvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
content: 抵達後，向毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者問訊後，在一旁坐下。(74)

original: 75.‘‘ Tesaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anupubbiṃ kathaṃ[ ānupubbikathaṃ( sī. pī.)] kathesi, seyyathidaṃ– dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.

original: Yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi– dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ.

original: Seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evameva khaṇḍassa ca rājaputtassa tissassa ca purohitaputtassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi–

original: ‘ yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman’ ti.
content: 『凡任何[[samudayaṃ#集法]]那個全部是[[nirodhaṃ#滅法]]。』(75)

original: ‘ abhikkantaṃ, bhante, abhikkantaṃ, bhante.

content: 大群人的出家

Tesaṃ vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādapiyamānānaṃ samuttejiyamānānaṃ sampahaṃsiyamānānaṃ nacirasseva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
content: 當他們被毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者以法說開示、勸導、鼓勵、使歡喜時，不久就不執取後心從諸漏被解脫。(85)

original: Cārikāanujānanaṃ
content: 遊行的允許

original: 86.‘‘ Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā mahābhikkhusaṅgho paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ.
content: 比丘們！當時，六百八十萬比丘的大比丘僧團居住在邦都馬低王都。

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi–
content: 比丘們！那時，獨處的、獨坐的毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者這樣心的深思生起：

original: ‘ mahā kho etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ, yaṃnūnāhaṃ bhikkhū anujāneyyaṃ–
content: 『現在，六百八十萬比丘的大比丘僧團居住在邦都馬低王都，讓我允許比丘們：

original: ‘ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ;
content: 「比丘們！為了眾人的利益，為了眾人的安樂，為了世間的憐愍，為了天-人們的需要、利益、安樂，請你們進行遊行，

original: mā ekena dve agamittha;
content: 不要兩個同一地走[SN.4.5]。

original: desetha, bhikkhave , dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
content: 比丘們！請你們教導開頭是善的、中間是善的、結尾是善的；[[sātthaṃ#有意義的]]、[[sabyañjanaṃ#有文字的]]法，請你們說明完全圓滿、[[kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti/pakāsetha#遍純淨的梵行]]，

original: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
content: 有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。

original: Api ca channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā’’’ ti.
content: 此外，每經過六年，為了[[pātimokkha#波羅提木叉]]的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』(86)

original: 87.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, aññataro mahābrahmā vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya.
content: 那時，某位大梵王以心了知毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者心中的深思後，就猶如有力氣的男子能伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，

original: Evameva brahmaloke antarahito vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa purato pāturahosi.
content: 就像這樣梵天世界消失，出現在毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的面前。

original: Atha kho so, bhikkhave, mahābrahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！那時，那位大梵王置(作)上衣到一邊肩膀、向毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者合掌鞠躬後，對毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者說這個：

original: ‘ evametaṃ, bhagavā, evametaṃ, sugata.
content: 『這是這樣，世尊！這是這樣，善逝！

original: Mahā kho, bhante, etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ, anujānātu, bhante, bhagavā bhikkhū–
content: 大德！現在，六百八十萬比丘的大比丘僧團居住在邦都馬低王都，大德！請世尊允許比丘們：

original: ‘‘ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ;
content: 「比丘們！為了眾人的利益，為了眾人的安樂，為了世間的憐愍，為了天-人們的需要、利益、安樂，請你們進行遊行，

original: mā ekena dve agamittha;
content: 不要兩個同一地走。

original: desetha, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
content: 比丘們！請你們教導開頭是善的、中間是善的、結尾是善的；有意義的、有文字的法，請你們說明完全圓滿、遍純淨的梵行，

original: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro’’ ti[ aññātāro( ssabbattha)].
content: 有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。」

original: Api ca, bhante, mayaṃ tathā karissāma yathā bhikkhū channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamissanti pātimokkhuddesāyā’ ti.
content: 此外，我們也將如比丘們每經過六年為了波羅提木叉的誦說將前往邦都馬低王都那樣做。』

original: Idamavoca, bhikkhave, so mahābrahmā, idaṃ vatvā vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tattheva antaradhāyi.
content: 比丘們！那位大梵王說這個，說這個後，那位大梵王向毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者問訊、作右繞後，就在那裡消失。(87)

original: 88.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者傍晚時，從獨坐出來，召喚比丘們：

original: ‘ idha mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi– mahā kho etarahi bhikkhusaṅgho bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ .

original: ‘ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ;
content: 『比丘們！為了眾人的利益，為了眾人的安樂，為了世間的憐愍，為了天-人們的需要、利益、安樂，請你們進行遊行，

content: 不要兩個同一地走。

content: 比丘們！請你們教導開頭是善的、中間是善的、結尾是善的；有意義的、有文字的法，請你們說明完全圓滿、遍純淨的梵行，

original: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
content: 有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。

original: Api ca, channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti.
content: 此外，每經過六年，為了波羅提木叉的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』」

original: ‘ ‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, aññataro mahābrahmā mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.

content: 大德！請世尊允許比丘們：

original: ‘ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ;
content: 「比丘們！為了眾人的利益，為了眾人的安樂，為了世間的憐愍，為了天-人們的需要、利益、安樂，請你們進行遊行，

original: mā ekena dve agamittha;
content: 不要兩個同一地走。

original: desetha, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ… pe… santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā , assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro’ ti.
content: 比丘們！請你們教導……法……（中略）有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。」

original: Api ca, bhante, mayaṃ tathā karissāma, yathā bhikkhū channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamissanti pātimokkhuddesāyā’’ ti.
content: 此外，我們也將如比丘們每經過六年為了波羅提木叉的誦說將前往邦都馬低王都那樣做。』

original: Idamavoca, bhikkhave, so mahābrahmā, idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tattheva antaradhāyi’.
content: 比丘們！那位大梵王說這個，說這個後，那位大梵王向我問訊、作右繞後，就在那裡消失。

original: ‘ ‘‘ Anujānāmi, bhikkhave, caratha cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ;
content: 比丘們！我允許：為了眾人的利益，為了眾人的安樂，為了世間的憐愍，為了天-人們的需要、利益、安樂，請你們進行遊行，

original: mā ekena dve agamittha;
content: 不要兩個同一地走。

original: desetha, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
content: 比丘們！請你們教導開頭是善的、中間是善的、結尾是善的；有意義的、有文字的法，請你們說明完全圓滿、遍純淨的梵行，

original: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
content: 有少塵垢之類的眾生以法的未聽聞情況而退失，他們將會是法的了知者。

original: Api ca, bhikkhave, channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā’ ti.
content: 此外，每經過六年，為了波羅提木叉的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yebhuyyena ekāheneva janapadacārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu.
content: 比丘們！那時，比丘們大多數就在一天中出發到鄉下(地方)遊行。(88)

original: 89.‘‘ Tena kho pana samayena jambudīpe caturāsīti āvāsasahassāni honti.
content: 當時，在閻浮洲有八萬四千個住處，

original: Ekamhi hi vasse nikkhante devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ–
content: 在一年已結束(已離去)時，天神們使聽到聲音：

original: ‘ nikkhantaṃ kho, mārisā, ekaṃ vassaṃ;
content: 『[[mārisa#親愛的先生]]！一年已結束，

original: pañca dāni vassāni sesāni ;
content: 現在有五年剩餘，

original: pañcannaṃ vassānaṃ accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā’ ti.
content: 經過五年，為了波羅提木叉的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』

original: Dvīsu vassesu nikkhantesu… tīsu vassesu nikkhantesu… catūsu vassesu nikkhantesu… pañcasu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ–
content: 在二年已結束時……在三年已結束時……在年四已結束時……在五年已結束時，天神們使聽到聲音：

original: ‘ nikkhantāni kho , mārisā, pañcavassāni;
content: 『親愛的先生！五年已結束，

original: ekaṃ dāni vassaṃ sesaṃ;
content: 現在有一年剩餘，

original: ekassa vassassa accayena bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṅkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyā’ ti.
content: 經過一年，為了波羅提木叉的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』

original: Chasu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddamanussāvesuṃ–
content: 在六年已結束時，天神們使聽到聲音：

original: ‘ nikkhantāni kho, mārisā, chabbassāni, samayo dāni bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamituṃ pātimokkhuddesāyā’ ti.
content: 『親愛的先生！六年已結束，現在，為了波羅提木叉的誦說，邦都馬低王都應該被前往。』

original: Atha kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū appekacce sakena iddhānubhāvena appekacce devatānaṃ iddhānubhāvena ekāheneva bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ upasaṅkamiṃsu pātimokkhuddesāyāti[ pātimokkhuddesāya(?)].
content: 比丘們！那時，比丘們一些以自己的神通威力，一些以天神們的神通威力，就在一天中為了波羅提木叉的誦說，前往邦都馬低王都。』(89)

original: 90.‘‘ Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhusaṅghe evaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisati–
content: 比丘們！在那裡，毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在比丘僧團中這麼誦說波羅提木叉：

original: ‘ Khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā,
content: 『忍辱、忍耐是最高的苦行，

original: Nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā;
content: 諸佛說涅槃是最高的，

original: Na hi pabbajito parūpaghātī,
content: 出家者確實是不惱害他人者，

original: Na samaṇo[ samaṇo( sī. syā. pī.)] hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.
content: 沙門是不壓迫他人者。

original: ‘ Sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā;
content: 一切惡的不作，善的具足，

original: Sacittapariyodapanaṃ , etaṃ buddhānasāsanaṃ.
content: 自心淨化，這是諸佛的教說。

original: ‘ Anūpavādo anūpaghāto[ anupavādo anupaghāto( pī. ka.)], pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro;
content: 無斥責、無惱害的，以及在波羅提木叉中[[saṃvaraṃ#自制]]，

original: Mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañca sayanāsanaṃ;
content: 在食物上知量，以及對[[pantāni senāsanāni#邊地臥坐處]]，

original: Adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhānasāsanan’ ti.
content: 以及在增上心上努力，這是諸佛的教說。』[Dhp.14, 183-185偈, ≃AA.48.2](90)

original: Devatārocanaṃ
content: 天神的告知

original: 91.‘‘ Ekamidāhaṃ, bhikkhave, samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.
content: 比丘們！有這一次，我住在屋葛德幸運林沙羅王樹下。

original: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi–
content: 比丘們！獨處的、獨坐的我這樣心的深思生起：

original: ‘ na kho so sattāvāso sulabharūpo, yo mayā anāvutthapubbo[ anajjhāvuṭṭhapubbo( ka. sī. ka.)] iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi.
content: 『那個[[sattāvāsā#眾生住處]]是不易獲得的形色：凡經這長時間除了{{note|trigger=淨居天|text=「首陀會天(DA.1)」，南傳作「淨居天」(suddhāvāsehi devehi, suddhāvāsā devā)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「純潔住所」(Pure Abodes)。按：「首陀會」顯然是「淨居」的音譯，此即證阿那含果(不還果)的聖者往生的五個不還天。}}外以前未被我輪迴者，

original: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena suddhāvāsā devā tenupasaṅkameyyan’ ti.
content: 讓我去淨居天。』

original: Atha khvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ subhagavane sālarājamūle antarahito avihesu devesu pāturahosiṃ .
content: 比丘們！那時，我就猶如有力氣的男子能伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，就像這樣在屋葛德幸運林沙羅王樹下消失，出現在無煩天中。

content: 比丘們！像這樣，如來的頗善通達的這個法界，以該法界的善通達狀態，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：『那些世尊是這樣血統。』

original: ‘ Evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ’ itipīti.
content: 這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣的法……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』

original: ‘ ‘ Devatāpi tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ, yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ’ itipi.
content: 天神也告知如來這個義理，以那個，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：『那些世尊是這樣血統。』

original: ‘ Evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ’ itipī’’ ti.
content: 這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣的法……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』」

original: Idamavoca bhagavā.
content: 世尊說這個，

original: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
content: 那些悅意的比丘歡喜世尊的所說。(94)

original: Mahāpadānasuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ paṭhamaṃ.
content: [[apadāna#阿波陀那]]大經第一終了。
